official_measurement_examples.name: Current EV PDR consultation status
official_measurement_examples.fact: The November 2025 consultation on further EV charging PDR changes is closed; its cross-pavement and multiple-equipment proposals must not be treated as enacted merely because they were consulted on.

official_measurement_examples.name: Existing 2025 PDR changes
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government's detailed consultation records that May 2025 amendments already changed existing off-street EV chargepoint PDRs, including taller upstands and equipment housing in non-domestic off-street car parks.

official_measurement_examples.name: Street works permit access
official_measurement_examples.fact: DfT guidance published 19 March 2026 says EV chargepoint operators can use street works permits to install chargepoints and related equipment on the public highway under the changed regime.

official_measurement_examples.name: Permit-scheme effective date
official_measurement_examples.fact: Updated street works permit-scheme statutory guidance applies from 10 April 2026 and reflects EV chargepoint operators' access to permit schemes.

official_measurement_examples.name: Public rapid reliability rule
official_measurement_examples.fact: Public Charge Point Regulations guidance requires operators' rapid public chargepoint networks of 50kW and above to average at least 99% availability over the calendar year.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 grant portfolio
official_measurement_examples.fact: OZEV states five chargepoint grant schemes are available until 31 March 2027 and some other schemes closed to customer applications on 31 March 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Approved Document S scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document S provides Building Regulations guidance for EV chargepoint and cable-route infrastructure in specified new and renovated buildings.

official_measurement_examples.name: LEVI status evidence
official_measurement_examples.fact: LEVI capital tables were updated 30 April 2026 with funding allocations and project status; funding status is not evidence an individual chargepoint is built or permitted.
